_note: THE SUITE LOADS dist FOR CORE. It imports `@cotal-ai/core`, whose exports point at ./dist/index.js, so mutating packages/core/src leaves the module the run actually uses untouched; the command rebuilds core from the mutated source, and `afterRestore` rebuilds it from the restored source so dist is not left carrying the last mutant. The two manager mutations need neither: the child loads ../src/manager.js through tsx. D2a and D2b are graded on the numbers rather than on behaviour ON PURPOSE - each leaves the reconcile in place, so the manager still survives the stall and every behavioural cell still passes while the slack that makes waiting safe is gone. Arithmetic is the only thing that catches that, and saying so is better than a behavioural cell that would not. ONE CHANGE IN THIS PR IS DELIBERATELY UNGRADED, and saying so is better than letting the kill count imply otherwise: the unconfirmed-lease window is measured on `performance.now()` rather than `Date.now()`, so an NTP correction or a suspend/resume cannot shorten it and let an instance serve past the TTL with no proof. No cell here can catch a revert of that, because reddening it needs the process clock to step backwards mid-run, and the only ways to arrange that are to doctor the code under test or to move the machine's clock. The initial value is -Infinity so the default is fail-closed either way, and that part IS reachable: preserve-state drives the lease-loss exit with no confirmation ever recorded and still fail-closes, now naming the reason.
